text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen. Narita Brian, 
hailed as the "strongest." Yet she 
declared that it was her Trainer who made 
her that way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Lining up for the race were the promising 
rising star Mayano Top Gun and the newly 
returned Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With unwavering confidence, Narita Brian 
boldly faces down her rivals—!
